      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "C",
        "I"
      ],
      "Attack": "An attacker could observe the OneWire waveform or inject altered bus data so that a different command or payload is transmitted.",

        "bus_req_i.data"
      ],

        "onewire_o"
      ],

        "Confidentiality": "yes",

      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "C",
        "I"
      ],
      "Attack": "An attacker could monitor the bus readback or spoof OneWire bits and presence so software receives confidential or incorrect response data.",
      "Enters Through": [
        "onewire_i"
      ],
      "Leaves Through": [
        "bus_rsp_o.data"
      ],
      "Entry Lines": [
        296
      ],

        162

        "Confidentiality": "yes",

      "Concept Name": "OneWire peripheral enable state",
      "Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Information": "The runtime enable state activates the OneWire engine, clock generation, and FIFO operation, and controls the external clock-enable output.",

        152

      "Concept Name": "OneWire service interrupt request",
      "Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Information": "The interrupt request reports that the peripheral is enabled, the transmit FIFO is empty, and the serial engine is idle so the host can service the peripheral. It has no entry port because it is generated from internal control and engine state.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",

        243
      ],

        243
      ]
    }
  ],
  "Not Kept": [
    {
      "Candidate Name": "FIFO and serial shift-register copies of transmit data",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Merged Into": "C1",
      "Why Not Kept": ""
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "FIFO and serial shift-register copies of received data",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Merged Into": "C2",
      "Why Not Kept": ""
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "FIFO clear command",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The command only clears FIFO buffers, which the Port buffers rule excludes as an information piece of its own."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "FIFO occupancy and serial busy status",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "These are buffer or sequencing status bits reported by readback and are excluded by the Buffer and engine status bits rule."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Serial engine sequencing state and counters",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The state, bit counter, timing counter, tick pulses, busy flag, and done flag only sequence or pace transfers and are barred by the Sequencing state and Pacing pulses rules."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Bus access handshake and error response",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The acknowledge repeats the request strobe and the error response is tied to a constant at lines 136 and 137, so neither is an independent security asset."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Clock and reset inputs",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "Clock and reset inputs are explicitly excluded from conceptual assets."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "ONEWIRE_FIFO build-time depth",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_onewire",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The FIFO depth is a generic build-time value at lines 20 and 176 to 209 that no element can change or withhold at run time."
    }
  ],
  "Notes": [
    "The closed set tags serial.presence as copied, but RTL line 375 assigns the inverse of serial.wire_in(1), not an unchanged copy."
  ]
}
